records.simp: 照片印出来以后，颜色有点错位。
records.english: When the photo was printed, the colors were slightly misaligned.

records.simp: 他摔了一跤，肩膀错位了。
records.english: He fell and dislocated his shoulder.

records.simp: 你的作文里有好几个错别字。
records.english: There are several wrongly written characters in your essay.

records.simp: 写完以后再检查一下有没有错别字。
records.english: When you're done, check again for any wrong characters.

records.simp: 这份报纸上居然有错别字。
records.english: This newspaper actually has typos in it.

records.simp: 这件事背后的关系错综复杂。
records.english: The relationships behind this matter are extremely tangled.

records.simp: 墙后面的电线错综复杂，别乱动。
records.english: The wires behind the wall are a tangled mess; don't mess with them.

records.simp: 老城区的小路错综复杂，很容易迷路。
records.english: The lanes of the old town are a maze; it's easy to get lost.

records.simp: 这部小说的人物关系错综复杂。
records.english: The relationships among the characters in this novel are very intricate.

records.simp: 他们家的情况错综复杂，外人很难明白。
records.english: Their family situation is complicated, and it's hard for outsiders to understand.

records.simp: 我有一种错觉，好像以前来过这里。
records.english: I have the illusion that I've been here before.

records.simp: 是我的错觉吗？今天他好像不太高兴。
records.english: Is it just me, or does he seem a bit unhappy today?

records.simp: 浅色的衣服会给人一种变胖的错觉。
records.english: Light-colored clothes can make you look heavier than you are.

records.simp: 锡很软，熔点也不高。
records.english: Tin is soft and has a low melting point.

records.simp: 这把壶是用锡做的。
records.english: This pot is made of tin.

records.simp: 这面锦旗上写着八个金色的大字。
records.english: This silk banner has eight large gold characters on it.

records.simp: 警察找回了她的钱包，她送去一面锦旗表示感谢。
records.english: The police found her wallet, so she sent them a silk banner to say thanks.

records.simp: 我们班在比赛中得了一面锦旗。
records.english: Our class won a silk banner in the competition.

records.simp: 病人给医生送来一面锦旗。
records.english: A patient brought the doctor a silk banner.

records.simp: 办公室的墙上挂满了锦旗。
records.english: The office wall is covered with silk banners.

records.simp: 这把锯太旧了，锯不动木头。
records.english: This saw is too old; it can't cut through wood.

records.simp: 把那把锯拿给我。
records.english: Hand me that saw.

records.simp: 遇到危险时，她表现得很镇定。
records.english: She stayed very calm in the face of danger.

records.simp: 墙上镶嵌着很多彩色的玻璃。
records.english: The wall is inlaid with lots of colored glass.

records.simp: 湖像一面镜子，镶嵌在群山之间。
records.english: The lake is like a mirror set among the mountains.

records.simp: 这枚戒指上镶嵌着一颗钻石。
records.english: This ring is set with a diamond.

records.simp: 这张桌子的边上镶嵌了贝壳。
records.english: The edge of this table is inlaid with shells.

records.simp: 他们走完这段长征用了一年多。
records.english: It took them more than a year to finish this long march.

records.simp: 学习汉语就像一次长征，要有耐心。
records.english: Learning Chinese is like a long march; you need patience.

records.simp: 爷爷给我讲了很多长征的故事。
records.english: Grandpa told me many stories about the Long March.

records.simp: 创业是一场长征，不能急。
records.english: Starting a business is a long journey; you can't rush it.

records.simp: 这部电影讲的是红军长征。
records.english: This film is about the Red Army's Long March.

records.simp: 这种防蚊水是长效的，一次能管一整天。
records.english: This mosquito repellent is long-lasting; one application lasts a whole day.

records.simp: 我们要建立长效的管理办法。
records.english: We need to set up a long-term management system.

records.simp: 这种化肥是长效的，可以用很久。
records.english: This fertilizer is long-lasting and works for a long time.

records.simp: 医生给我开了长效的止疼药。
records.english: The doctor prescribed me a long-acting painkiller.

records.simp: 这种药是长效的，一天吃一次就够了。
records.english: This medicine is long-acting; once a day is enough.

records.simp: 长期以来，这里的交通一直很不方便。
records.english: Transport here has long been very inconvenient.

records.simp: 长期以来，她一个人照顾生病的妈妈。
records.english: For a long time she has looked after her sick mother on her own.

records.simp: 长期以来，大家都认为这是不可能的。
records.english: For a long time, everyone thought this was impossible.

records.simp: 长期以来，他一直住在这个小镇上。
records.english: He has lived in this small town for a long time.

records.simp: 长期以来，这个问题没有人管。
records.english: For a long time no one has dealt with this problem.

records.simp: 她的长相很像她妈妈。
records.english: She looks a lot like her mother.

records.simp: 别只看一个人的长相。
records.english: Don't judge a person only by their looks.

records.simp: 这个城市的经济有了长足的发展。
records.english: This city's economy has grown enormously.

records.simp: 公司的技术有了长足的发展。
records.english: The company's technology has advanced considerably.

records.simp: 这几年，他的汉语有了长足的进步。
records.english: In the past few years, his Chinese has made remarkable progress.

records.simp: 近年来，医学取得了长足的进步。
records.english: In recent years medicine has made great strides.

records.simp: 经过一年的训练，她的成绩取得了长足的提高。
records.english: After a year of training, her results improved dramatically.

records.simp: 家里的长辈都很疼爱这个孩子。
records.english: The older members of the family all dote on this child.

records.simp: 和长辈说话要有礼貌。
records.english: Be polite when you talk to your elders.

records.simp: 过年的时候，我们要给长辈拜年。
records.english: At New Year we pay our respects to our elders.

records.simp: 这里的冬天长达半年。
records.english: Winter here lasts as long as half a year.

records.simp: 他们开了一个长达五个小时的会。
records.english: They held a meeting that lasted as long as five hours.

records.simp: 这条河长达几千公里。
records.english: This river is several thousand kilometers long.
